title: HostToolchain
description: Machine-local resolved host toolchain for solid_sdd runs. Written by scripts/solidsdd-host-toolchain.sh to .solidsdd/host-toolchain.json (typically gitignored). Agents must copy preferred commands into Task prompts and must not rediscover npm/node via find.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the consuming project root that was probed.

resolved_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this file was written.

ready.description: True when minimum tools for detected stack verify commands are resolvable without LLM search.

missing.description: Tool ids required by stack that were not resolved.

path.description: Absolute path when found; null when missing.

tools.description: Map of tool id → resolution result (node, npm, npx, bundle, ruby, go, redocly, mise, …).

commands.description: Preferred shell snippets for Task prompts (e.g. npm_test, openapi_lint). Agents must use these instead of searching.

hints.description: Short remediation hints when ready is false (mise activate, PATH, etc.).
